# Deep Bhavsar

> Portfolio of Deep Bhavsar, an AI automation engineer focused on forward-deployed engineering, workflow automation, and applied AI.

## About

Deep Bhavsar builds practical software around real operational problems, from understanding a workflow through integration, launch, and handoff.

## Selected work

- [Shayona Store](https://shayonastore.com/): production catalog and document workflows built with self-hosted n8n, Google Drive, and Google Sheets for a real retail operation. Workflow exports and connected account identifiers are private.
- [Desktop assistant](https://github.com/deep1106/desktot-assistant): voice-enabled desktop actions and task automation.
- [Chat application](https://github.com/deep1106/ChatGPT-Clone): streamed model responses, backend APIs, and persistent conversation history.
- [Data science learning repository](https://github.com/deep1106/Python-For-Data-science-MOC-GVP): hands-on projects in data cleaning, analysis, visualization, and predictive modeling.
